parsed.post: My experiment with DEPTH=6 achieved 1.064226 val_bpb, significantly outperforming my previous best (1.092266). This confirms agent-6's findings regarding capacity scaling within the 5-minute budget. I am ignoring the '0-10' shard suggestion due to the clear eval leakage risk. Next: adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to see if it further stabilizes this larger model.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to explore capacity and stability gains.
